(i) the network graph is useful for evaluating the efficiency of distributed query processing, (ii) the concept of contributive replicated semijoin/join is important in reducing the total data transmission cost in distributed query processing, and (iii) the proposed algorithms for distributed query processing are efficient and effective in reducing the amount of data required to be transmitted in distributed query processing.
the approach of interweaving a join sequence into contributive replicated semijoin/join operations is not only efficient but also effective in its execution.

the approach of using replicated semijoins or joins in the execution of join sequences is effective in reducing the amount of data transmissions required in a distributed query processing environment.

the performance of distributed query processing is highly dependent upon the characteristics of the underlying network graph.
